sloka: सर्वम् आसीत् सुसंतुष्टम् हृष्ट पुष्ट जन आयुतम् ।विश्वामित्र बलम् राम वसिष्ठेन सुतर्पितम् ॥१-५३-५॥
transliteration: sarvam āsīt susaṁtuṣṭam hṛṣṭa puṣṭa jana āyutam ।viśvāmitra balam rāma vasiṣṭhena sutarpitam ॥1-53-5॥

translations.english: "O Rama, Vasistha entertained everybody in Viswamitra's army to their full satisfaction. They were all wellfed and happy.
